ISO-001.title: Certificate Freshness Model
ISO-001.certificate_binding_model: Commit-bound snapshot certification where the certificate records the active Git HEAD commit hash, current ISO timestamp, and individual status modules.
ISO-001.freshness_semantics: Verification uses the latest Git commit hash as the repository state boundary. Working tree changes and DB index freshness are compared against the DB snapshot marker.
ISO-001.self_reference_analysis: The certificate path 'repository_health_certificate.json' is excluded from the list of protected files checked by the integrity validator, preventing circular self-reference loop conditions.

ISO-002.title: Certificate Consumption Boundary
ISO-002.certificate_consumption_path: global_validate.py -> main() -> _enforce_repository_health_certificate_if_applicable() -> blocks execution if the certificate is invalid or missing, otherwise prints confirmation and runs math validations directly.

ISO-005.title: Failure Isolation
ISO-005.failure_behavior: Mathematical validations fail immediately with exit code 1 if the health certificate is invalid or missing, preventing execution of math code.
